abstract: OBJECTIVE: To describe the clinical and ultrasound characteristics of three types of rare malignant ovarian germ cell tumor: embryonal carcinoma, non-gestational choriocarcinoma and malignant mixed germ cell tumor. METHODS: This was a retrospective multicenter study. From the International Ovarian Tumor Analysis (IOTA) database, we identified patients with a histological diagnosis of ovarian embryonal carcinoma, non-gestational choriocarcinoma or malignant mixed germ cell tumor, who had undergone preoperative ultrasound examination by an experienced ultrasound examiner between 2000 and 2020. Additional patients with the same histology were identified from the databases of the departments of gynecological oncology in the participating centers. All tumors were described using IOTA terminology. Three examiners reviewed all available ultrasound images and described them using pattern recognition. RESULTS: One patient with embryonal carcinoma, five patients with non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma and seven patients with ovarian malignant mixed germ cell tumor (six primary tumors and one recurrence) were identified. Seven patients were included in the IOTA studies and six patients were examined outside of the IOTA studies. The median age at diagnosis was 26 (range, 14-77) years. Beta-human chorionic gonadotropin levels were highest in non-gestational choriocarcinomas and alpha-fetoprotein levels were highest in malignant mixed germ cell tumors. Most tumors were International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO) Stage I (9/12 (75.0%)). All tumors were unilateral, and the median largest diameter was 129 (range, 38-216) mm. Of the tumors, 11/13 (84.6%) were solid and 2/13 (15.4%) were multilocular-solid; 9/13 (69.2%) manifested abundant vascularization on color Doppler examination. Using pattern recognition, the typical ultrasound appearance was a large solid tumor with inhomogeneous echogenicity of the solid tissue and often dispersed cysts which, in most cases, were small and irregular. Some tumors had smooth contours while others had irregular contours. CONCLUSIONS: A unilateral, large solid tumor with inhomogeneous echogenicity of the solid tissue and with dispersed small cystic areas in a young woman should raise the suspicion of a rare malignant germ cell tumor. This suspicion can guide the clinician to test tumor markers specific for malignant germ cell tumors. © 2020 International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology.
abstract_ja:
目的：3種類の稀な悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍、すなわち胎児性癌、非妊娠性絨毛癌、悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的および超音波的特徴を記述すること。
方法：後方視的多施設研究である。International Ovarian Tumor Analysis(IOTA)データベースから、卵巣胎児性癌、非妊娠性絨毛癌、または悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の組織学的診断を受け、2000年から2020年の間に経験豊富な超音波検査者による術前超音波検査を受けた患者を同定した。同じ組織型の追加患者を、参加施設の婦人科腫瘍学部門のデータベースから同定した。すべての腫瘍はIOTAの用語を用いて記述した。3名の検査者が利用可能な超音波画像をすべて見直し、パターン認識を用いて記述した。
結果：胎児性癌1例、非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌5例、悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍7例(原発6例、再発1例)が同定された。7例はIOTA研究に含まれ、6例はIOTA研究外で検査された。診断時の年齢中央値は26歳(範囲14～77歳)であった。β-hCG値は非妊娠性絨毛癌で最も高く、αフェトプロテイン値は悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍で最も高かった。腫瘍の大部分は国際婦人科産科連合(FIGO)病期I(9/12、75.0%)であった。全腫瘍は片側性で、最大径の中央値は129mm(範囲38～216mm)であった。腫瘍のうち11/13(84.6%)は充実性、2/13(15.4%)は多房性充実性であった。9/13(69.2%)はカラードプラで豊富な血流を示した。パターン認識による典型的な超音波所見は、充実成分の不均一なエコー輝度を伴う大きな充実性腫瘍で、しばしば散在する囊胞を伴い、その多くは小さく不整であった。滑らかな輪郭を持つ腫瘍もあれば、不整な輪郭を持つ腫瘍もあった。
結論：若年女性における、充実成分の不均一なエコー輝度を伴い、散在する小囊胞領域を伴う片側性の大きな充実性腫瘍は、稀な悪性胚細胞腫瘍の疑いを生じさせるべきである。この疑いは、悪性胚細胞腫瘍に特異的な腫瘍マーカーの検査へ臨床医を導きうる。
